profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, operating as part of the Abu Dhabi Government's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC), which oversees technology research in the emirate. The institute describes itself as a leading global research center dedicated to pushing the frontiers of knowledge, with teams of scientists, researchers, and engineers working across areas that include robotics, cybersecurity, materials science, and advanced physics. It is a non-profit organization by structure.

In AI, TII is best known for Falcon, an open-source large language model released under the Apache 2.0 license and hosted in the UAE with Middle East data residency. The project is positioned as a sovereign AI initiative, meaning it is designed to keep data and model infrastructure within the region rather than relying on external cloud providers. Falcon is tracked in the Chat and General LLMs category and has its own dedicated site at falconllm.tii.ae.

The held facts record no litigation and no MCP server presence associated with TII. The institute has a verified profile on theworldofai.org as of August 2026.
